heading: Short title and commencement.
text:
(1) This Act may be called the Navy Act, 1957.

(2) It shall come into force on such date[1] as the Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint.
notes: 1st January, 1958, vide notification S.R.O. 11(E), dated 31st December, 1957, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, 1958, Part II, s. 4(ii).
